reference_path_correction.finding: The pinned Windows reference reuses a ggml threadpool state object, but OpenMP supplies workers and barriers. The custom ggml hybrid polling worker path is not active. Recorded measurements and harness sources are unchanged.
reference_path_correction.build_evidence: Release ggml-cpu.vcxproj enables OpenMPSupport and defines GGML_USE_OPENMP.

limitations: Operation timers include worker scheduling and waiting within each operation; they do not yet distinguish those costs from computation.
Three processes per arm/count/model with two measured sequences each; means and medians differ in some cases. This cannot establish a small speedup or replace uninstrumented external comparisons.
Final-vector FNV64 identity matches the uninstrumented warmup, across measured runs, source arms and thread counts. This is a harness consistency witness, not a new independent HF numerical gate.
